notes: Calorie-and-macro chain, 3 London sites (Farringdon, Soho, Wembley, from the homepage's Find the Bites), one chain-wide guide. Compared every one of the 49 printed dishes against the PDF pages rendered at 40 dpi and looked at by eye (all 7 pages) and against Tesseract OCR of the pages rendered at 200 dpi (a different method from the script's pdftotext text layer): 45 dishes matched kcal, fat, carbs and protein exactly by OCR (OCR reads some trailing 'g' as 9: 44g as 449, 27g as 279, 3.5g as 3.59, 2.7g as 2.79, each confirmed by eye); the other 4 (Crispy Tofu Noodle Salad, Teriyaki Tofu Wrap, BBQ Sauce Chicken Wrap, Chicken Karaage) were not located by OCR and were confirmed by eye on the page image. 0 mismatches. Held back (printed as is, not corrected): 869/48/76/31 is printed for Omurice and Rice bowl 'Katsu Crispy Shrimp Curry' and for 'Crispy Shrimp Tempura'; 848/44/72/38 for Omurice 'Sweet & Sour Chicken' and 'Teriyaki Chicken'; Noodle bowls 'Miso Roasted Chicken' (5.7g carbs, 560 kcal) and 'Teriyaki Chicken' (5.6g carbs, 570 kcal) cannot add up. Crunchy wrap names take the bold sauce at the start of each row (Korean Sauce, Sriracha Mayo, Teriyaki, BBQ Sauce) for the Chicken and Prawn wraps beside it: the layout shows one row per sauce, but the guide does not say it in words.
